t_advice_summary_textbox.text: In the game, each gnome appears in pairs, orange & pink etc. Each gnome corresponds to a type of forest: dark or light. The success in the game hinges on the ability to collect as many mushrooms as possible based on the type of forest, the task is to remember which type of forest contains the most mushrooms. The order in which the gnomes appear on screen and the amount of mushrooms available in each type is random, memory, speed & high concentration are the key to obtaining mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Hi there,This game hinges on the player utilising two key characteristics: the colours of the gnomes and how they correspond to the forest and memorising the amount of mushrooms in those forests.The gnomes are always presented in pairs with the same colours each time, orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow and blue & purple. Remember these colours could be in different sequences. They each correspond to a type of forest: orange, green, red and blue = bright forest and brown, pink, yellow and purple = dark forest. The yellow gnome can be difficult to remember at first as it is a bright colour but corresponds to a dark forest, so it may be worth memorising this. The objective is to go to the forest that has the most mushrooms at any given time, this changes constantly but consistently remembering which colour corresponds to each type of forest makes this much easier. As said, going to the correct forest each time allows you to obtain as many mushrooms as possible, do not randomly select colours as you will be collecting a lot of zero's.The way the gnomes are dressed and appearance is irrelevant, stay focused and concentrate on the colour of gnome and how many mushrooms you are collecting in each forest and you should collect lots.Hopefully this is helpful and good luck!
